nodes.label: Decision log (decisions.md)
Decision: all packages to their latest release, except TypeScript 7 and Tauri 3
nodes.rationale: Old versions would only make later updates bigger; vue-tsc cannot run on TypeScript 7 (no lib/tsc); Tauri 3 is an alpha. Rejected: staying on old versions; TypeScript 7 without template type-checking.

nodes.label: Decision: pnpm pinned to 12 in packageManager and devEngines; pnpm-workspace.yaml allows the esbuild and vue-demi build scripts
nodes.rationale: node_modules came from pnpm 10 while the machines run newer versions; same setup as smtp-relay. Rejected: no pin; pinning the installed 11.3.

nodes.label: Decision: a CredentialStore trait and a driver factory in ConnectionHandler
nodes.rationale: Repository and pool can be tested without the keyring and without MongoDB; the commands no longer downcast the repository.

nodes.label: Decision: database access through a DatabaseDriver trait with a factory per ConnectorKind
nodes.rationale: Room for more drivers or a second MongoDB implementation.

nodes.label: Decision: dependency injection on both sides (Tauri managed state in Rust, provider registry with useDomain in Vue)
nodes.rationale: Services are created once and can be swapped behind an interface (ConnectionService, ConnectionRepository, LogStrategy).

nodes.label: Decision: Tauri 2 with a Rust core and a Vue 3 web view
nodes.rationale: README: high-performance backend with secure system-level access; modern, responsive, maintainable frontend; goal is a free European alternative to Studio 3T.

nodes.label: Decision: commands that talk to MongoDB take a connection id; Rust loads the saved connection and its password
nodes.rationale: The UI copy can be stale after an edit, and the password no longer passes through the web view for these calls. Rejected: sending the connection object.

nodes.label: Decision: a driver leaves the pool on disconnect, edit, delete and when its first command fails
nodes.rationale: A driver is created before the server is contacted, so a wrong password or an edited host stuck until restart. Rejected: keeping drivers for the life of the process.

nodes.label: Decision: connection model version 2 (target + options for host targets; connectionType dropped; v1 migrated and kept as connections.v1.json)
nodes.rationale: Connection strings and options (issue #4) were out of reach with a host field and a hand-built URL; connectionType was never read. Rejected: keeping connectionType; options for both modes overriding the string.

nodes.label: Decision: a connection string keeps all its options; its credentials move out on save and go back only in memory before parsing
nodes.rationale: One place per setting and no password in connections.json; the driver checks authMechanism against the user info. Rejected: storing the string as typed.

nodes.label: Decision: the driver gets ClientOptions instead of a URL string
nodes.rationale: No hand-made percent-encoding, and srv strings work. Rejected: fixing the URL building.

nodes.label: Decision: host options TLS, CA file, invalid certificates, replica set, server selection timeout
nodes.rationale: What issue #4 asked for, without client certificates. Rejected: more fields such as read preference; those go into a connection string.

nodes.label: Decision: no credentials in logs; the connection URI logged only in debug builds with the password masked
nodes.rationale: The URI carries the password.

nodes.label: Decision: the edit dialog shows the stored password, fetched from the keyring only when it opens
nodes.rationale: Users wanted to see and fix the password they saved; partly reverses "credentials never reach the frontend" of PR #23. Rejected: keeping the password write-only.

nodes.label: Decision: testing a connection is optional; a connection can be saved untested
nodes.rationale: Issue #26 gives no reason. Rejected: requiring a successful test before saving.

nodes.label: Decision: credentials stay in Rust; get_connections and get_connection never return a password
nodes.rationale: Passwords should not be exposed to the web view, and the grid should not hit the keyring for every connection. Rejected: hydrating passwords when listing.

nodes.label: Decision: connections stored as a versioned JSON object keyed by id
nodes.rationale: O(1) access by id, and a version to migrate the file when its shape changes. Rejected: a plain array of connections.

nodes.label: Decision: keyring 4 with its default v1 mode (Keychain, Credential Manager, Secret Service); reverses the keyutils cache
nodes.rationale: All packages were updated; keyring 4 moved its stores into separate crates and v1 keeps the API; keyring 3 passwords stay readable. Rejected: keyring-core with chosen store crates; staying on keyring 3.6.

nodes.label: Decision (superseded): Linux keyring via linux-native-sync-persistent with vendored OpenSSL
nodes.rationale: keyutils for fast kernel-level access during a session, Secret Service for persistence; vendored bundles OpenSSL. Rejected: sync-secret-service alone.

nodes.label: Decision: passwords stored in the OS keyring through the keyring crate
nodes.rationale: Uses the native store on Windows, macOS and Linux. Rejected: Tauri Stronghold (added 2026-02-15, reverted 2026-02-17).

nodes.label: Decision (superseded): password set on the URL with Url::set_password (percent-encoded)
nodes.rationale: Passwords with special characters failed with "password must be URL encoded" (issue #21).

nodes.label: Decision: only basic authentication (username, password, authentication database) for the MVP
nodes.rationale: "For MVP, Basic is sufficient" (issue #3). Rejected: other mechanisms for now.

nodes.label: Decision: the connection test skips serverStatus without the privilege, reads the version from buildInfo, marks failing stages failed, and its events carry a test id
nodes.rationale: A user who may only read one database failed the test although connecting worked; a failed stage stayed grey; two tests could not be told apart. Rejected: dropping the status stage.

nodes.label: Decision: CredentialsUnavailable, ConnectionNotFound and StorageFailed variants; a failed find carries the server message
nodes.rationale: A keyring failure read as a host problem; a broken query only said "check your permissions".

nodes.label: Decision: logs at Debug in development builds, Info in release builds
nodes.rationale: Release builds logged everything at debug.

nodes.label: Decision: errors shown as vue-sonner toasts instead of an error box per component
nodes.rationale: Cleaner, less duplicated code and styling, fits the theme (issue #36). Rejected: the error boxes of before.

nodes.label: Decision: testing, connecting and finding documents run as cancellable background tasks with an id
nodes.rationale: A slow connection froze the UI and there was no way to give up (issue #27). Rejected: a timeout only.

nodes.label: Decision: the connection test streams each stage as a Tauri event
nodes.rationale: Each stage shows when it really finishes, not all at once.

nodes.label: Decision: every error carries kind, message and user_message; the UI shows user_message
nodes.rationale: Raw driver errors were long and unreadable (issue #16). Rejected: showing the raw error.

nodes.label: Decision: one driver per connection id kept for the life of the process (later revised)
nodes.rationale: Reuse the MongoDB client connection pool across commands.

nodes.label: Decision: several connections open at once; disconnecting closes the connection tabs; each tab belongs to its connection
nodes.rationale: Working with two servers is common; tabs used to survive a switch of connection and query the new server. Rejected: closing all tabs on switching; keeping tabs per connection while only one is open.

nodes.label: Decision: every tab has exactly one view keyed by its own id; mod+enter runs only in the active tab
nodes.rationale: Views multiplied and ran duplicate queries, and Ctrl+Enter ran everywhere (issue #42).

nodes.label: Decision: paging, total count, sort and projection in the query tab; paging repeats the executed query
nodes.rationale: Issue #12 listed them; typing must not change what the next page means.

nodes.label: Decision: an empty filter is counted with estimatedDocumentCount (marked as estimate), a filter exactly
nodes.rationale: countDocuments scans a big collection. Rejected: always counting exactly; no count.

nodes.label: Decision: documents leave Rust as relaxed extended JSON, an Int64 beyond +/-2^53 as $numberLong
nodes.rationale: Readable dates in the JSON view and no silent change of large integers. Rejected: canonical extended JSON.

nodes.label: Decision: the query parser checks every shell function and produces only shapes bson reads as types; regexes as $regularExpression
nodes.rationale: Invalid or date-only values silently matched nothing.

nodes.label: Decision: the table renders only visible rows (TanStack Virtual), caches formatted cells and sizes columns from a sample
nodes.rationale: Bigger result sets render fast (PR #44, issue #39).

nodes.label: Decision: documents shown in a table by default, JSON second; column order saved per connection, database and collection
nodes.rationale: The commit gives no reason for the default.

nodes.label: Decision: the query input is a single-line CodeMirror editor with MongoDB autocomplete
nodes.rationale: The history gives no reason.

nodes.label: Decision: shell-style queries parsed by an own parser (src/utils/queryParser) into extended JSON, which bson turns into BSON in Rust
nodes.rationale: It accepts unquoted keys, single quotes and shell functions like ObjectId(...) that JSON does not; the history gives no reason for not using a library.

nodes.label: Decision: open tabs stay mounted (v-show and KeepAlive) so a tab keeps its query and results
nodes.rationale: Switching tabs lost the state. Rejected: v-if.

nodes.label: Decision: forms on TanStack Form with zod 4 and shadcn-vue Field
nodes.rationale: @vee-validate/zod only supports zod 3; vee-validate 5 has been a beta since 2025; shadcn-vue documents TanStack Form. Rejected: vee-validate 5 beta, an own adapter for vee-validate 4, keeping zod 3.

nodes.label: Decision: a ConfirmDialog with useConfirm() instead of the browser confirm()
nodes.rationale: It fits the app and will be needed for deleting data.

nodes.label: Decision: shortcuts on mod (Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere); on macOS the default menu without "Close Window"
nodes.rationale: Mac users expect Cmd; Cmd+W would otherwise close the app. Not checked on a Mac.

nodes.label: Decision: the sidebar has one node per open connection with refresh, edit and disconnect; the grid gives way once a connection is connected
nodes.rationale: Editing must work while connected; the view switches only on success (issue #27).

nodes.label: Decision: Roboto bundled with the app
nodes.rationale: The font of the built app looked wrong (issue #30). Rejected: the system font.

nodes.label: Decision: the default window is 1200 x 900
nodes.rationale: The history gives no reason.

nodes.label: Decision: vitest in happy-dom with Tauri mockIPC; Rust unit tests with an in-memory credential store and temp dirs; integration tests against a real MongoDB marked #[ignore]
nodes.rationale: The rule "every piece of logic gets unit tests"; keyring and MongoDB cannot be in the default run. Rejected: mounting components in tests (logic moved into modules instead).

nodes.label: Decision: docs/ documents features, architecture, decisions and plans; CLAUDE.md holds the working rules
nodes.rationale: The project is being revived; its state had to be written down first, and work should follow the same rules as the other projects.

nodes.label: Decision: Claude Code gets a graphify knowledge graph; only the semantic cache is committed, each clone builds the graph
nodes.rationale: Same setup as smtp-relay: the cache saves the model cost of reading the docs again, and graph.json is rewritten whole on every rebuild. Rejected: committing graph.json; ignoring graphify-out/ completely.

nodes.label: Decision: feature branches off develop merged through GitHub pull requests; develop goes to main from time to time
nodes.rationale: The history records no reason.

nodes.label: smtp-relay (sibling project used as template for docs, pnpm pin and graphify setup)
